title: release-openclaw-plugin

goal.text: Publish a verified OpenClaw plugin release.

requirements.summary: Release only the OpenClaw adapter artifact family without npm publication.
acceptanceCriteria: Selected candidates, source manifests, exact CLI runtime pins and DSH mapping agree with the target CLI base; missing/stale authorized platforms were prepared and frozen before promotion, not silently shipped at an older base.
Candidate preparation allocated the family-specific target version; promotion preserves it unchanged.
Focused OpenClaw checks and the guarded release verifier pass.
The exact vopenclaw-<version> tag and GitHub Release are verified.

tasks.title: Inspect and classify the OpenClaw baseline
tasks.detail: Before selecting any beta or formal candidate, read docs/beta-release.md and resolve the target CLI base and authorized families. Run npm run audit:release-versions with --phase beta|release, --artifacts <authorized-families>, and each frozen --candidate when applicable. Show source/candidate/known-public versions and exact CLI pins for all families. A selected platform with a missing/stale candidate needs fresh latest-source preparation and freezing at that base before promotion; never relabel frozen artifacts or publish an older CLI to disguise mismatch. Other platforms are inventory only until scope expansion is authorized. Each new candidate requires its own trial or explicit owner waiver. Select the authorized tested frozen candidate and verify its artifact family, sourceRevision and trial; absent a candidate, use candidate preparation and wait for its own trial or an explicitly recorded owner waiver before publication. Read AGENTS.md and references/artifact.md; inspect branch, remotes, tags, manifests, dependency pins, and every worktree change.

tasks.title: Confirm the frozen candidate version and source
tasks.detail: Read the selected candidate and its source manifest mirrors, exact dependency pins and sourceRevision. Verify the allocated family-specific version; do not bump, regenerate or synchronize workspace content during promotion. Any mismatch requires a new candidate/version, not an in-place repair.

tasks.title: Verify the OpenClaw candidate
tasks.detail: Require the selected frozen candidate inventory/hash, exact clean source revision, retained test evidence and seven-day trial or explicitly recorded owner waiver. Read-only checks may verify template driver compatibility, but never build, export, bump or repair source during promotion. A changed input requires a new candidate.

tasks.title: Pass the exact-source gate and release
tasks.detail: With explicit publication authority, require clean source main at the tested candidate revision and complete authorized source push without divergence. Publish the exact frozen OpenClaw artifact tree to the existing immutable vopenclaw-<candidate-version> tag and GitHub Release through its artifact owner. Record source and artifact commits separately and compare the public tree with the candidate. Never tag raw source as an installable artifact or regenerate the selected tree.

tasks.title: Verify the OpenClaw release
tasks.detail: Verify tag, GitHub Release artifact evidence, repository cleanliness, and only the separately authorized platform installation refresh.

rules: Inventory every platform, but never publish or prepare an unselected family without explicit authorization. Each selected candidate must align with the target CLI base; fourth segments remain independent.

Formal promotion requires the explicitly selected tested frozen candidate. Preserve its version and hashes; never bump, build, pack or export again. If no tested candidate exists, prepare a new version through beta:prepare and wait for its own trial or an explicitly recorded owner waiver before publication.
Never publish npm packages or modify another artifact family.
Stop at the first failed release boundary.
